# Catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run catalog` from the content folders. Do not edit by hand. -->

Rounded 0.1.0 ships 12 agents, 24 skills, 18 commands and 14 rules.
Items marked **core** are installed by the default `core` profile; `full` installs everything.

## Agents

Specialist subagents the main agent can delegate to.

| Agent | Core | Tools | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`architect`](../agents/architect.md) |  | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash | Designs systems and evaluates technical decisions — module boundaries, data models, APIs, scaling and trade-offs — and records them as decision records. |
| [`build-fixer`](../agents/build-fixer.md) | ✓ | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit | Gets a failing build, type check, lint or compile step back to green with the smallest correct change. |
| [`code-reviewer`](../agents/code-reviewer.md) | ✓ | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash | Reviews a diff or set of files for correctness bugs, security problems, maintainability and missing tests, and reports findings ranked by severity. |
| [`database-reviewer`](../agents/database-reviewer.md) |  | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash | Reviews schemas, migrations and queries for correctness, safety and performance — indexes, constraints, locking, data loss, N+1 access patterns. |
| [`debugger`](../agents/debugger.md) | ✓ | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write | Finds the root cause of a bug, crash, flaky test or unexpected behaviour through reproduction, hypothesis and evidence, then fixes it with a regression test. |
| [`doc-writer`](../agents/doc-writer.md) |  | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write | Writes and updates documentation that matches the code — READMEs, setup guides, API references, architecture notes and changelogs. |
| [`e2e-tester`](../agents/e2e-tester.md) |  | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write | Writes and runs end-to-end tests of critical user journeys in a real browser (Playwright by default), keeps them reliable, and diagnoses failures. |
| [`performance-analyst`](../agents/performance-analyst.md) |  | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write | Finds and fixes performance problems using measurement — slow endpoints, heavy queries, memory growth, large bundles, slow builds — and proves the improvement with numbers. |
| [`planner`](../agents/planner.md) | ✓ | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash | Turns a feature request or bug report into a concrete, ordered implementation plan grounded in the actual codebase. |
| [`refactorer`](../agents/refactorer.md) |  | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write | Improves the structure of existing code without changing its behaviour — removes dead code and duplication, splits large functions, clarifies names — with tests proving behaviour is preserved. |
| [`security-reviewer`](../agents/security-reviewer.md) | ✓ | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash | Audits code for security vulnerabilities — injection, broken access control, secrets, unsafe dependencies, insecure configuration — and proposes concrete fixes. |
| [`tdd-guide`](../agents/tdd-guide.md) | ✓ | Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write | Drives development test-first — writes a failing test that pins down the behaviour, makes it pass with the simplest code, then refactors. |

## Skills

Reusable know-how the agent loads when the task matches the description.

| Skill | Core | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| [`api-design`](../skills/api-design/SKILL.md) |  | Conventions for designing HTTP/JSON APIs that are consistent, evolvable and hard to misuse — resources, status codes, errors, pagination, versioning, idempotency and documentation. |
| [`ci-pipelines`](../skills/ci-pipelines/SKILL.md) |  | Designing fast, reliable and secure continuous-integration pipelines — stage ordering, caching, parallelism, flaky-test policy, required checks and least-privilege tokens, with GitHub Actions examples. |
| [`code-review`](../skills/code-review/SKILL.md) | ✓ | Checklist and method for reviewing code changes — correctness, security, data safety, tests, performance and maintainability — and for writing findings that are actionable. |
| [`containers-and-deploy`](../skills/containers-and-deploy/SKILL.md) |  | Building small, secure container images and deploying them safely — multi-stage Dockerfiles, non-root users, configuration through the environment, health checks, rollouts and rollbacks. |
| [`context-management`](../skills/context-management/SKILL.md) | ✓ | Keeping long AI-assisted coding sessions focused and recoverable — writing plans and handoff notes, checkpointing progress, choosing what to read, when to compact or start fresh, and delegating to subagents. |
| [`database-migrations`](../skills/database-migrations/SKILL.md) |  | How to change database schemas and data safely in production — expand/contract, zero-downtime patterns, batching backfills, locking pitfalls and rollbacks. |
| [`dependency-hygiene`](../skills/dependency-hygiene/SKILL.md) |  | Choosing, updating and auditing third-party dependencies — evaluating packages before adding them, lockfiles, update cadence, vulnerability triage, licence checks and supply-chain risks. |
| [`error-handling`](../skills/error-handling/SKILL.md) |  | Patterns for handling errors deliberately — where to catch, how to add context, typed errors versus exceptions, retries and timeouts, and what to show users versus log. |
| [`frontend-accessibility`](../skills/frontend-accessibility/SKILL.md) |  | Practical accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) for web interfaces — semantic HTML, keyboard support, focus management, labels, contrast, motion and testing with automated tools and screen readers. |
| [`git-workflow`](../skills/git-workflow/SKILL.md) | ✓ | Conventions for branches, commits, pull requests, rebasing, resolving conflicts and recovering from mistakes, including Conventional Commits messages. |
| [`go-patterns`](../skills/go-patterns/SKILL.md) | with go | Idiomatic Go — package design, small interfaces, explicit error handling with wrapping, context propagation, safe concurrency, and table-driven tests. |
| [`logging-and-observability`](../skills/logging-and-observability/SKILL.md) |  | How to make software observable with structured logs, metrics and traces — what to log at which level, correlation IDs, golden-signal metrics, alerting and keeping personal data out of telemetry. |
| [`performance-profiling`](../skills/performance-profiling/SKILL.md) |  | Measurement-driven performance work for backends, frontends and build pipelines — setting budgets, profiling CPU and memory, analysing queries, and common fixes with their trade-offs. |
| [`python-patterns`](../skills/python-patterns/SKILL.md) | with python | Modern, maintainable Python — project layout, type hints checked by a type checker, dataclasses and pydantic models, error handling, packaging with uv or poetry, and pytest testing. |
| [`react-patterns`](../skills/react-patterns/SKILL.md) |  | Patterns for maintainable React applications — component boundaries, state placement, effects, data fetching, forms, performance and testing with Testing Library. |
| [`refactoring-safely`](../skills/refactoring-safely/SKILL.md) |  | Step-by-step techniques for restructuring code without changing behaviour — characterisation tests, small reversible moves, dead-code removal, extracting modules and migrating callers incrementally. |
| [`release-management`](../skills/release-management/SKILL.md) |  | Versioning and shipping releases predictably — semantic versioning, changelogs, release checklists, tags, pre-releases, deprecations and hotfixes. |
| [`rust-patterns`](../skills/rust-patterns/SKILL.md) | with rust | Idiomatic Rust — ownership-friendly API design, error handling with Result, type-driven modelling, safe concurrency and async, unsafe discipline, and testing. |
| [`security-review`](../skills/security-review/SKILL.md) | ✓ | Practical security checklist for application code — input handling, authentication and authorisation, secrets, data protection, dependencies and configuration — with safe patterns for each. |
| [`systematic-debugging`](../skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md) | ✓ | A disciplined method for finding root causes — reproduce, observe, form hypotheses, bisect, fix and guard with a regression test — plus tactics for flaky tests, performance regressions and production-only bugs. |
| [`tdd-workflow`](../skills/tdd-workflow/SKILL.md) | ✓ | Red-green-refactor workflow for building features and fixing bugs test-first, with guidance on choosing the next test and keeping the loop short. |
| [`typescript-patterns`](../skills/typescript-patterns/SKILL.md) | with typescript | Idiomatic, type-safe TypeScript for applications and libraries — strict compiler settings, modelling data with unions, validating at boundaries, async patterns, module structure and testing. |
| [`writing-docs`](../skills/writing-docs/SKILL.md) |  | Writing documentation people can use — READMEs, how-to guides, API references, architecture decision records and changelogs — with structure templates and a verification checklist. |
| [`writing-tests`](../skills/writing-tests/SKILL.md) | ✓ | How to write tests that are fast, deterministic and meaningful — naming, structure, test doubles, fixtures, coverage targets and what to test at each level. |

## Commands

Slash commands for common workflows.

| Command | Core | Arguments | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/checkpoint`](../commands/checkpoint.md) | ✓ | `[optional note about what to do next]` | Save progress — commit finished work and write a handoff note for the next session |
| [`/commit`](../commands/commit.md) | ✓ | `[optional hint about intent or scope]` | Write a Conventional Commits message for the staged changes and commit |
| [`/debug`](../commands/debug.md) | ✓ | `<symptom, error message or failing test>` | Find the root cause of a bug systematically and fix it with a regression test |
| [`/deps-audit`](../commands/deps-audit.md) |  |  | Audit dependencies for vulnerabilities, outdated packages and licence issues, and propose safe updates |
| [`/docs`](../commands/docs.md) |  | `[what changed, or a path; default = recent changes]` | Update documentation to match the code after a change |
| [`/explain`](../commands/explain.md) |  | `<file, symbol, feature or question>` | Explain how a piece of code, module or flow works, with references |
| [`/fix-build`](../commands/fix-build.md) | ✓ | `[failing command; default = detect from the project]` | Get a failing build, type check or lint back to green with minimal, honest fixes |
| [`/onboard`](../commands/onboard.md) |  | `[optional focus area]` | Map an unfamiliar codebase and write a concise orientation guide |
| [`/plan`](../commands/plan.md) | ✓ | `<feature or change to plan>` | Explore the codebase and produce a step-by-step implementation plan before writing code |
| [`/pr`](../commands/pr.md) |  | `[base branch; default = main]` | Prepare a pull request — summary, testing notes, risks — from the current branch |
| [`/refactor`](../commands/refactor.md) |  | `<code or area to clean up, and the goal>` | Refactor code without changing behaviour, protected by tests |
| [`/release-notes`](../commands/release-notes.md) |  | `[from tag; default = latest tag]` | Draft release notes and the next version number from commits since the last tag |
| [`/resume`](../commands/resume.md) | ✓ |  | Pick up work from the last handoff note and plan |
| [`/review`](../commands/review.md) | ✓ | `[base branch or files; default = uncommitted changes]` | Review current changes (or a branch) for bugs, security issues and missing tests |
| [`/security-check`](../commands/security-check.md) |  | `[path or area to focus on]` | Audit the codebase or current changes for security vulnerabilities and leaked secrets |
| [`/tdd`](../commands/tdd.md) | ✓ | `<behaviour to implement or bug to fix>` | Implement a feature or fix test-first with a red-green-refactor loop |
| [`/test-coverage`](../commands/test-coverage.md) |  | `[path or module; default = whole project]` | Measure test coverage, find the riskiest untested code, and add meaningful tests |
| [`/verify`](../commands/verify.md) | ✓ | `[optional: quick \| full]` | Run every quality gate (build, types, lint, tests, security audit) and report a ship/no-ship verdict |

## Rules

Always-on guidelines. Common rules are always installed; language rules follow the detected or chosen languages.

| Rule | Applies to | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`common/agent-workflow`](../rules/common/agent-workflow.md) | all files | How to approach tasks — understand, plan, implement in small verified steps, and report honestly |
| [`common/coding-style`](../rules/common/coding-style.md) | all files | Language-agnostic code quality rules — naming, function size, immutability, comments and error handling |
| [`common/git`](../rules/common/git.md) | all files | Git rules — feature branches, Conventional Commits, no force-push to shared branches, never commit secrets |
| [`common/performance`](../rules/common/performance.md) | all files | Performance rules — measure before optimising, avoid N+1 queries and unbounded work |
| [`common/security`](../rules/common/security.md) | all files | Security rules — no secrets in code, validate input at boundaries, parameterise queries, least privilege |
| [`common/testing`](../rules/common/testing.md) | all files | Testing expectations — tests for every behaviour change, test-first for bugs, deterministic and fast suites |
| [`go/coding-style`](../rules/go/coding-style.md) | `**/*.go` | Go conventions — gofmt, explicit error handling with wrapping, context first, small consumer-side interfaces |
| [`go/testing`](../rules/go/testing.md) | `**/*_test.go` | Go testing — table-driven subtests, httptest, t.TempDir, race detector |
| [`python/coding-style`](../rules/python/coding-style.md) | `**/*.py` `**/*.pyi` | Python conventions — type hints, dataclasses, pathlib, specific exceptions, safe subprocess and deserialisation |
| [`python/testing`](../rules/python/testing.md) | `**/test_*.py` `**/*_test.py` `**/conftest.py` | Python testing with pytest — fixtures, parametrize, tmp_path, monkeypatch, frozen time |
| [`rust/coding-style`](../rules/rust/coding-style.md) | `**/*.rs` | Rust conventions — Result-based errors, no unwrap in production paths, clippy clean, documented unsafe |
| [`rust/testing`](../rules/rust/testing.md) | `**/*.rs` | Rust testing — unit tests beside code, integration tests in tests/, property tests, doc tests |
| [`typescript/coding-style`](../rules/typescript/coding-style.md) | `**/*.ts` `**/*.tsx` `**/*.mts` `**/*.cts` `**/*.js` `**/*.jsx` `**/*.mjs` `**/*.cjs` | TypeScript and JavaScript conventions — strict types, unions over flags, validation at boundaries, async discipline |
| [`typescript/testing`](../rules/typescript/testing.md) | `**/*.test.ts` `**/*.test.tsx` `**/*.spec.ts` `**/*.spec.tsx` `**/*.test.js` `**/*.spec.js` | TypeScript and JavaScript testing — runner conventions, Testing Library, network mocking, Playwright |
